text: As of 31 December 2025, TGH S.r.l. held 33.78% of Technogym S.p.A.'s share capital, representing 60.47% of the voting rights; the remaining 52.02% was free float on Euronext Growth Milan.
short: TGH S.r.l. holds 33.78% of Technogym (60.47% of voting rights).
